title: xDrip+Bubble
body: After the developer of the bubble updated the firmware of my device to 2.0 xDrip stopped receiving glucose data. In this case, the program from the developer of the bubble (diabox) receives data from the bubble device as expected.

comments.body:
Please use the latest xdrip nightly.
Issue is solved there.

Hey, I have same problem as OP, using latest original and nightly versions.
If I download the latest nightly release written on the date OP opened this issue, my Bubble connects without problems.
So looks like, the issue is back in the latest versions.
